entities.summary: Ganga Bharani Vasudevan is an Indian blogger-turned-writer. She is the author of the books Just You, Me and A Secret (2012), A Minute to Death (2015), A Sip of Love and a Sip of Coffee (2016) and Murder In The Elevator (2018).
